description_en: Retrieves the details of multiple client or server certificates by serial number
description_zh: 通过证书的序列号批量查询客户端证书或服务端证书的详细信息
name: DescribeClientCertificateForSerialNumber

parameters.help_en:
The serial numbers of the client or server certificates. Separate multiple serial numbers with a comma.

> Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html to query the serial numbers of all client and server certificates
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的序列号。多个序列号之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的序列号
parameters.name: serial_number
